bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
DEPLOY=deploy-gaybbs-1
CANDIDATE=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6
docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
docker inspect "$DEPLOY" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
docker run --rm --entrypoint node "$CANDIDATE" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 61
ACTIVE="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}')"
LOCAL="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 67
test "$ACTIVE" = "$LOCAL" || exit 34
COMPOSE="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || exit 35
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy config -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 72
exit 0
